dataset.note: 231 of JevBench v1.2's 534 total decisions are public (original 72, easy 48, hard 111); the remaining 303 (heldout 24, router 78, judge 68, easy-heldout 24, 109 more hard items) are deliberately unpublished by upstream and cannot be vendored here -- see benchmarks/jevbench/README.md.

model.calibration_note: raw (uncalibrated) probabilities by default -- PRD.md 13a.2/13a.5 found temperature scaling makes this architecture's ECE/Brier worse, not better; pass apply_temperature=True / --decoder-apply-temperature to override

results.note: n_supported_by_multischema_cap is how many items a decoder/multischema model could legitimately attempt (a 'choice' item with between 2 and max_options=26 options, whose gold label is one of them). is_complete_benchmark_score is true only when every real (non-selftest) item was both supported and attempted. See PRD.md Section 14 Q4 / 13a.5 and benchmarks/README.md before treating this file as a benchmark ranking.
